name: aerobrowse
title: AeroBrowse: The Featherweight AI Browser Engine
description: Dual-engine AI browser for autonomous agents, LLM pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients that cuts token usage by 88% using semantic AST pruning.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Navigates to a URL, performs semantic AST pruning, and returns clean Markdown with numbered Set-of-Marks Action IDs.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Dispatches a deterministic DOM click event using a numeric Action ID.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Fills text into an input field using a numeric Action ID.
